hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The promoted semantic-transduction champion is an irreversible forward path: once the representation-only engine has been emitted, the sole strength transducer may repair its own unfinished edit but no later executable evidence can reopen a mistaken semantic seam from the prior pass. Round 12's frontier-scoped realization was valid yet changed sign across the frozen anchor roles, and round 13's precommitted-map realization produced two valid but weaker descendants and was irreversibly rejected 0W/2L. These bounded outcomes do not identify an engine algorithm to tune; they show that valid fixed-path realizations can retain an upstream representation assumption that downstream construction has no action for revising.

causal_change.factor: Downstream-falsification control topology of the executable transduction lineage
causal_change.before: The lineage moves only forward from anchor to semantic-normal-form engine to final strengthened engine; after the strength pass exposes a cross-layer contradiction, no control edge can reopen the already emitted representation state.
causal_change.after: The same single engine lineage gains one bounded counterexample-triggered reentry edge: a reproducible task-general metamorphic counterexample that links the sole strengthened descendant to violation of an explicit normal-form invariant transitions construction from pending finalization back to semantic recompilation from its sole normalized predecessor, after which exactly one final engine is emitted.
causal_change.why_causal: The availability of a backward reentry transition determines whether downstream executable evidence can change an upstream representation decision rather than merely patch the terminal artifact. The trigger, state transition, and one-time recompilation are one control-topology factor. The normalizer and strength producer remain single, sequential transformations; no replicated agents, candidate variants, scoring, ranking, or best-of-N selection is introduced.

hypothesis.expected_effect: When a strength transformation creates a valid-looking engine whose behavior contradicts a semantic obligation established by normalization, the new path should reconstruct the affected representation and its dependent strength change together instead of preserving the contradiction or applying a terminal patch. Clean descendants should pass through unchanged. Across the matched batch this predicts zero invalid arms, candidate wins exceeding losses, and candidate-median Elo strictly above the incumbent median.
hypothesis.falsifier: Falsify the promotion prediction unless the applicable matched batch satisfies every frozen promotion condition. Mechanistically falsify the capability if a seeded task-general cross-consumer invariant violation does not activate semantic_reentry, if a clean descendant is rewritten, if reentry becomes repeated open-ended iteration, or if the finalizer creates or compares multiple candidate engines instead of recompiling the one lineage once.
hypothesis.behavioral_novelty: The loop can use a downstream executable counterexample to reopen an upstream representation decision and recompile the same strengthened lineage once. The champion can only continue forward and repair within its currently active pass; it cannot transition from a completed strength descendant back into semantic construction.

emergent_capability.champion_limitation: After the champion's semantic normalizer emits its engine, downstream evidence cannot reopen that representation pass; the final strength call can only repair its own current transformation before emission.
emergent_capability.emergent_capability: On one reproducible task-general metamorphic counterexample that causally links the sole strengthened descendant to a violated normal-form invariant, re-enter semantic construction from the sole normalized predecessor and recompile the affected representation plus dependent strength transformation into one final engine.
emergent_capability.trigger: A bounded metamorphic probe over the sole strengthened descendant reproduces a cross-consumer behavior that contradicts an explicit invariant of its normalized predecessor and survives one confirmation run; legality failure, Elo, benchmark output, subjective critique, or mere source difference is not a trigger.

state_transition.before: strength_descendant_pending_finalization with the semantic-normal-form boundary closed
state_transition.after: semantic_reentry_active with one minimized counterexample and the sole normalized predecessor, followed by exactly one obligation-checked recompiled final engine

emergent_capability.observable_effect: Given the same normalized predecessor and a strengthened descendant containing a reproducible cross-layer invariant violation, the champion can only finish its forward strength pass, while the candidate records the semantic_reentry transition and reconstructs the violated seam and its dependent strength logic together. With no qualifying counterexample, the candidate returns the strengthened descendant byte-for-byte.
emergent_capability.novelty_probe: In an isolated task-general probe, supply a normalized predecessor and one direct strengthened descendant with a seeded mismatch between a state transition and one of its declared consumers. Verify that the mismatch triggers exactly one semantic_reentry and disappears in the sole final engine; then supply a clean descendant and verify byte-for-byte pass-through with no reentry.
emergent_capability.not_local_refinement: This is a new evidence-triggered backward control edge and construction-state transition, not a narrower normalization boundary, different target timing, added packet field, certificate, audit relocation, reviewer, gate, role rename, or finer terminal patch.

strengths: Preserves one nonbranching anchor-derived engine lineage and the supported semantic-normal-form representation.
Adds a concrete recovery action for downstream evidence that implicates an upstream semantic seam.
Uses an executable causal trigger rather than Elo, benchmark cases, subjective review, or source-diff heuristics.
Bounds reentry to once and emits one final engine without replicated candidates or best-of-N selection.
risks: The metamorphic probes may not expose playing-strength regressions that preserve all declared semantic invariants.
A false-positive invariant can trigger unnecessary recompilation and erase a useful strength change.
Reconstructing representation and strength logic in one bounded final call may exceed available reasoning or introduce new defects.
Byte-for-byte pass-through on the no-trigger path depends on the final call faithfully preserving the supplied descendant.

structure.name: Counterexample-Reentrant Semantic Transduction
structure.information_flow: One executable lineage moves from champion_engine to semantic_normalizer_engine to provisional_strength_engine. A final counterexample_recompiler_engine receives exactly those two related engine states, runs a bounded task-general causal trigger, and either passes the sole descendant through unchanged or performs one semantic-reentry recompilation from its sole normalized predecessor; it always emits exactly one final engine.

calls.objective: Transform exactly one supplied anchor engine into exactly one complete runnable canonical engine. Expose UCI handling, legal move generation, make/unmake, hashing, repetition state, evaluation state, and search state through explicit single-source transitions. Declare task-general executable invariants for those seams within the engine's source or behavior so a downstream call can probe them. Use bounded in-call equivalence and invariant checks and repair only this unfinished transformation until consistent. Preserve search policy and evaluation intent; do not introduce strength changes, alternative implementations, candidate variants, or selection.

Consume the sole canonical engine and emit exactly one complete strengthened descendant. Diagnose and implement one coherent task-general algorithmic improvement through its canonical seams, then run bounded legality, UCI, state-integrity, and tactical sanity checks. Repair the same unfinished transformation in place if a check fails. Do not tune engine hyperparameters as the structural change, generate alternatives, compare variants, invoke an external reviewer, or perform preserve-versus-rollback selection. This artifact is the sole descendant passed to the bounded semantic-reentry stage, not one option in a candidate set.

Consume exactly one normalized predecessor and its sole direct strengthened descendant. Run bounded task-general metamorphic probes against explicit normal-form invariants. If no reproducible counterexample causally links the descendant to an invariant violation, emit the supplied descendant byte-for-byte. If exactly one such counterexample is reproduced and confirmed, transition once to semantic_reentry: return to the sole normalized predecessor and recompile the implicated semantic seam together with its dependent strength logic into exactly one complete final engine, then rerun the counterexample and core legality, UCI, and state checks. Never trigger on benchmark results, Elo, subjective quality, or source difference; never iterate reentry, patch the descendant locally, roll back selected deltas, generate alternatives, compare engines, or choose best-of-N.
